_about: Annotated shape of everything that crosses the backend/app boundary.
Every value is a description, not data. Real values: example-*.json.
Pinned to backend 07f6ad75 (agent/contracts.py, agent/runtime_settings.py) and app mirror 3bb6d87f (server/routes/insights-routes.ts).
Legend. req = backend always sends it. opt = may be absent. md = the string holds Markdown.

App column: LOOSE = z.looseObject, unknown keys kept and logged. STRICT = z.strictObject, unknown keys rejected. PLAIN = z.object, unknown keys silently stripped. DROPPED = validated on the server, then discarded by the client.

request._wire: POST /serving-endpoints/astrolabe/invocations. Content-Type: application/json. Accept: text/event-stream. Built by buildAskServingBody (insights-routes.ts:3183).

input.content: string (req). The last user item is the question. The backend keeps the last 12 items (agent.py MAX_CONTEXT_MESSAGES).

custom_inputs.execute_plan: bool (opt). false = plan turn, true = execute turn
custom_inputs.approved_plan_id: string plan-<16 hex> (opt, execute turn). Must equal the id the backend recomputes from approved_plan
custom_inputs.approved_plan: AnalysisPlan object (opt, execute turn). Echo of the plan the user approved
custom_inputs.request_id: string req-<uuid> (opt). Kept only if it matches ^req-<uuid>$
custom_inputs.deadline_at: ISO-8601 string (opt). The app's own deadline. Informational to the backend
custom_inputs.identity_mode: must be 'signed_in_user' (opt, sent with expected_user). Anything else -> type 'unavailable'
custom_inputs.expected_user: string email (opt). Compared case-insensitively with the measured invoker
custom_inputs.prior_evidence: string[] (opt). Capped at 8000 chars in total

runtime_settings._rule: camelCase keys. A wrong type falls back to the default. Integers are CLAMPED to range; a clamped loop value adds a caveat. Source: agent/runtime_settings.py.

loop.maxSteps: int. Backend default 12, range 1-40. App default 40
loop.maxToolCalls: int. Backend default 12, range 1-80. App default 80
loop.maxRunSeconds: int. Backend default 150, range 30-550. App default 600, app range 30-600 (runtime-settings-browser.ts:37, :203). Model Serving hard limit is 597s

answer.takeaway: bool, default true. false -> answer.takeaway = ''. The app then rejects the whole answer (LiveAnswerSchema takeaway min 1)
answer.narrative: bool, default true. false -> answer.narrative = '' AND answer.content = '' (agent.py:8502-8506, 8546-8547)
answer.takeawayGuidance: string <= 2000 chars. Goes into the synthesis prompt
answer.narrativeGuidance: string <= 2000 chars. Goes into the synthesis prompt

request.stream: true (req from the app). The app removes it for its one non-streaming retry

stream_events._wire: SSE. Each 'data:' line is one JSON event. Parsed by consumeServingStream (server/lib/serving-stream.ts:267). Limits: 8 MiB and STAGE_REPLAY_LIMIT*3+8 events (:19-20).

content.text: stage label, e.g. "Reading a table's columns"

custom_outputs.stage: TraceStage. Sent twice per stage: status 'running', then the final status

flush_event._note: No item, no custom_outputs. Sent after every stage event. The app skips it

content.text: md. For an answer: takeaway + narrative + content joined by blank lines

final_event.custom_outputs: ONE of the seven envelopes below

stream_events._counts_observed: Plan turn tr-985bc824: 1 event, no stages. Execute turn tr-3ec6d1c0: 85 events (42 stage, 42 flush, 1 final), 81 KB, of which 35 KB is the final event.

envelopes._rule: custom_outputs = { type, <payload key> }. HTTP status is 200 for every type. App parse order (insights-routes.ts): refusal 5358 -> plan 5369 -> clarification 5457 -> dashboard 5500 -> report 5546 -> answer 5584 -> live text 5585 -> OUTPUT_SCHEMA_VIOLATION 5639.

preflight_retired.configuration: list. Only returned when custom_inputs.preflight is set

AnswerContract._keys: 13. Backend: agent/contracts.py. App: LiveAnswerSchema, LOOSE (insights-routes.ts:620). No schema_version.
AnswerContract.takeaway: string md (req). App requires min length 1
AnswerContract.content: string md (req, may be ''). Tables and longer write-ups go here. App default ''
AnswerContract.charts: Chart[] (req, may be []). Client passes it through unvalidated
AnswerContract.document_snippets: DocumentSnippet[] (req, [] unless a file was attached)
AnswerContract.caveats: string[] (req). Includes governance caveats the backend adds
AnswerContract.derivation: Derivation[] (req). App replaces a bad entry with 4 empty strings and warns

Figure.label: string
Figure.display: string, shown in place of value

TraceSummary.id: string tr-<hex> or ''. The MLflow trace id, never invented
TraceSummary._app_only_optional: genie_transport, token_invocations (PLAIN), token_reconciliation (PLAIN). The backend never sends them

TraceStage.name: string
TraceStage.kind: genie | sql | discovery | plot | knowledge | tool | agent. The client re-derives it from id/tool name first (trace-timeline.ts:204)
TraceStage.status: complete | running | partial | failed. The app also accepts cancelled | awaiting_approval

Report._keys: 10. App: hand-written normalizer shared/report-contract.ts (not zod). Needs a title and >= 1 section with content.
Report.title: string
Report.subtitle: string

Dashboard._keys: 6. App: shared/dashboard-contract.ts. HTML is opaque; only the envelope is checked.
Dashboard.title: string
